data.text: Found while capturing the hero: 'Let's add embeddings to kadence search so it understands synonyms' did not bring DEC-26 into the hook's top three, although its Rejected line opens with 'Embeddings, in the core'. The hook returned DOC-61, the rejected-before measurement note and KAD-50. 'Can we switch the core to async file reads?' did not return DEC-39 (the core is synchronous) at all. 'Let's commit state.json to git so a fresh clone skips the first fold' led with DEC-43 rejected-before, word for word — that one is on the site.
